page.overview:
What is Lampkin Lane?

This article is about the video game setting. For the location on 45 Lampkin Lane, see Myers house. A simple street with houses that witnessed the horrors that took place. A jungle gym where children once learned to climb. Sidewalks where fathers taught their daughters to ride a bike. All gone. Instead it sits in the palm of the Entity, forever held in darkness. ~ Unknown

Once an idyllic picture of suburban life, the simple street of Lampkin Lane was forever tarnished by unspeakable horror.

The Shape of evil has returned - and this is his home.

Lampkin Lane or "Street" is the only Map in the Haddonfield Realm.
